name: get_posts
description: Fetch all fake blog posts for testing and prototyping. Returns post ID, user ID, title, and body text.

limit.description: Maximum number of posts to return (default 10, max 100).

name: get_post
description: Fetch a single fake blog post by ID (e.g., "1"). Returns post ID, user ID, title, and body text.

name: get_users
description: Fetch all fake users for testing. Returns name, username, email, address, phone, website, and company details.

name: get_comments
description: Fetch comments for a specific post by post ID (e.g., "1"). Returns comment ID, commenter name, email, and body text.

post_id.description: Post ID whose comments to retrieve (1–100).
